children: On October 7, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below that level. Nasdaq granted 180 days, until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance by achieving a $1.00 closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days; trading continues on Nasdaq under XWEL.
